# Duplicator

> > Duplicator is the leading WordPress backup, migration, and disaster recovery plugin trusted by over 1.5 million users worldwide.

Duplicator Pro provides comprehensive WordPress site management through automated backups, 1-click migration, cloud storage integration, and disaster recovery capabilities. The plugin supports multiple cloud storage providers including Amazon S3, Google Drive, Dropbox, and OneDrive, with military-grade encryption and restore wizards for seamless WordPress operations.

## Key Topics

- WordPress Backup
- 1-Click Migration

- WordPress Multisite
- WooCommerce Backups
- Amazon S3
- Google Drive

- Encryption
- 1-Click Restore
- Backup Scheduling
- Object Storage
- Hosting Migration
